title: Repository Guidelines
text: R/ houses exported client functions internal helpers; group workflows domain (auth, resources, steps). inst/ ships CLI binaries, templates, runtime assets bundled package. man/, doc/, docs/, vignettes/, pkgdown/ support roxygen docs pkgdown site; update via devtools release. tests/testthat/ contains automated specs; test-*.R files run default, _test-*.R hold optional credentialed scenarios. Package metadata lives DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, Meta/; keep sync roxygen2 updates.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Rscript -e "devtools::load_all()" reloads package iterative development. Rscript -e "devtools::test()" executes full testthat suite; target single file testthat::test_file(). Rscript -e "devtools::check()" wraps R CMD check; resolve notes warnings pushing. Rscript -e "pkgdown::build_site()" rebuilds documentation site output docs/.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Use tidyverse R style: 2-space indents, space commas, snake_case locals; exported APIs stay UpperCamelCase (loadResource() loadResource.R). Invoke packages explicitly pkg::fn() prefer glue error text. Keep roxygen2 blocks current run devtools::document() whenever signatures change. Avoid side effects load; place initialization helpers dedicated files R/.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Adopt testthat 3rd edition conventions; create new specs usethis::use_test("feature") consistent scaffolding. Mock HTTP traffic httptest fixtures possible store cassettes alongside tests. Reserve _test-*.R long-running credentialed flows CI remains fast reproducible.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Craft concise, present-tense summaries (<=72 chars), mirroring history like introducing collapsible callouts getStep details; elaborate body needed. Reference issues #123 mention improve platform tickets bodies. Verify devtools::check() targeted smoke tests opening PR; attach run output logs. PR descriptions capture motivation, behavior changes, screenshots CLI transcripts user-facing.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Keep pkgdown navigation _pkgdown.yml aligned new articles reference sections. Update vignettes long-form guides vignettes/ workflows change prevent drift.

title: Basic Node Types
text: Files standard digital files stored repository full version control.
code:
cat("
=== Creating Files ===
")  # Create a sample data file sampleData <- data.frame(   id = 1:10,   value = rnorm(10),   category = sample(c("A", "B", "C"), 10, replace = TRUE) )  # Save locally first write.csv(sampleData, "sample_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)  # Upload to repository dataFile <- createFile(   targetIdent = rawDataFolder$entityId,   fileName = "sample_data.csv",   localPath = "sample_data.csv",   comment = "Sample dataset for tutorial" ) cat("Created file:", dataFile$path, "
") cat("Entity ID:", dataFile$entityId, "
") cat("Version ID:", dataFile$entityVersionId, "
")  # Create an R script file scriptContent <- '# Simple analysis script data <- read.csv("sample_data.csv") summary(data) plot(data$value, main = "Sample Data Values") '  writeLines(scriptContent, "analysis_script.R")  scriptFile <- createFile(   targetIdent = scriptsFolder$entityId,   fileName = "analysis_script.R",   localPath = "analysis_script.R",   comment = "Basic analysis script" ) cat("
Created script:", scriptFile$path, "
")  # Clean up local files unlink(c("sample_data.csv", "analysis_script.R"))

title: Basic Node Types
text: Every change file creates new version, preserving complete history.
code:
cat("
=== File Versioning ===
")  # Modify the data file modifiedData <- sampleData modifiedData$value <- modifiedData$value * 2 modifiedData$new_column <- runif(10)  write.csv(modifiedData, "sample_data_v2.csv", row.names = FALSE)  # Update the file (creates new version) updatedFile <- updateFileContent(   ident = dataFile$entityId,   localPath = "sample_data_v2.csv",   comment = "Updated data with new column and scaled values" )  cat("Original version:", dataFile$entityVersionId, "
") cat("New version:", updatedFile$entityVersionId, "
") cat("Entity ID (unchanged):", updatedFile$entityId, "
")  # View file history history <- loadHistory(dataFile$entityId)$data[[1]] cat("
=== File History ===
") print(history[, c("entityVersionId", "lastModifiedOnDate", "comment")])  # Clean up unlink("sample_data_v2.csv")

title: Basic Node Types
text: Links stable pointers specific versions resources. ensure referential integrity always pointing version unless explicitly updated.
code:
cat("
=== Creating Links ===
")  # Create a link to the current version of our data file dataLink <- createLink(   links = updatedFile$entityVersionId,   linkName = "stable_data_link",   linkContainer = outputsFolder$resourceId ) cat("Created link:", dataLink$path, "
") cat("Link points to version:", dataLink$targetRevisionId, "
") cat("Target file version:", updatedFile$entityVersionId, "
")  # Now update the data file again cat("
=== Updating the File Again ===
") finalData <- modifiedData finalData$value <- finalData$value * 1.5 finalData$final_column <- "final_version"  write.csv(finalData, "sample_data_v3.csv", row.names = FALSE)  # Create another new version finalFile <- updateFileContent(   ident = dataFile$entityId,   localPath = "sample_data_v3.csv",   comment = "Final update with additional changes" )  cat("New file version created:", finalFile$entityVersionId, "
")  # Check that the link still points to the old version cat("
=== Link Stability After File Update ===
") linkCheck <- updateResource(dataLink$entityId) cat("Link still points to version:", linkCheck$targetRevisionId, "
") cat("Current file version:", finalFile$entityVersionId, "
") cat("Link is stable: ", linkCheck$targetVersionId == updatedFile$resourceVersionId, "
")  # Update the link to point to the new version cat("
=== Updating the Link ===
") updatedLink <- updateLinks(   links = dataLink$entityId,   comment = "Updated link to point to latest version" ) updatedLink <- updateResource(dataLink$entityId) cat("Link now points to version:", updatedLink$resourceVersionId, "
") cat("Matches current file version:", updatedLink$targetVersionId == finalFile$resourceVersionId, "
")  # Clean up unlink("sample_data_v3.csv")

cat("
=== Modifying Files Locally ===
")  # Read the current sample data file local_data_path <- file.path(CLI_WORKSPACE, "data", "raw", "sample_data.csv") if (file.exists(local_data_path)) {   local_data <- read.csv(local_data_path)   cat("Original data dimensions:", nrow(local_data), "x", ncol(local_data), "
")      # Modify the data   local_data$cli_modified <- TRUE   local_data$timestamp <- Sys.time()   local_data$new_values <- runif(nrow(local_data))      # Save the modified file   write.csv(local_data, local_data_path, row.names = FALSE)   cat("Modified data dimensions:", nrow(local_data), "x", ncol(local_data), "
")   cat("Added columns: cli_modified, timestamp, new_values
") } else {   stop("Expected sample_data.csv not found. Please check Tutorial 01 completion.") }  # Create a new file new_script_path <- file.path(CLI_WORKSPACE, "scripts", "cli_analysis.R") new_script_content <- '# Analysis script created via CLI tools # Created: %s  # Load the modified data data <- read.csv("../data/raw/sample_data.csv")  # New analysis cat("Data has CLI modifications:", "cli_modified" %%in%% names(data), "\n") cat("Number of records:", nrow(data), "\n")  # Summary of new values summary(data$new_values) ' writeLines(sprintf(new_script_content, Sys.Date()), new_script_path) cat("
Created new script: scripts/cli_analysis.R
")

title: CLI tools
text: Locking prevents users modifying resources ’re working . Since folder locking currently working, ’ll lock single file instead.
code:
cat("
=== Locking Resources ===
")  # Load the sample data file we'll be working with dataFile <- loadResource("./data/raw/sample_data.csv", from = tutorialResource) cat("File to lock:", dataFile$path, "
")  # Lock the single file lockResult <- lockResource(dataFile$entityId) cat("Locked file:", dataFile$name, "
")  # Check lock status lockedFile <- updateResource(dataFile$entityId) cat("
Lock status:
") cat("Locked by:", lockedFile$lockedByName, "
") cat("Locked at:", as.character(lockedFile$lockedAt), "
")  # Store the locked file ID for later unlock LOCKED_FILE_ID <- lockedFile$entityId

title: CLI tools
text: Remove link locally push deletion.

cat("
=== Deleting Link Locally ===
")  # Delete the link file link_path <- file.path(CLI_WORKSPACE, "outputs", "cli_modified_data_link") if (file.exists(link_path)) {   unlink(link_path,force = T)   cat("Deleted local link file
") }  # Push the deletion  pushResult <- pushCli(   localPath = CLI_WORKSPACE ) cat("
Push completed. Deletion sent to repository.
")   # Verify deletion on server outputsChildren <- updateChildResources(outputsFolder)$data[[1]] remainingLinks <- outputsChildren[grep("link", outputsChildren$name), "name"] cat("
Remaining links in outputs folder:",      if(length(remainingLinks) > 0) paste(remainingLinks, collapse = ", ") else "none", "

title: CLI tools
text: Finally, unlock file allow others modify .

cat("
=== Unlocking Resources ===

Lock status after unlock:
")   cat("lockedByName" %in% names(unlockedFile))   cat("File name:", unlockedFile$name, "

title: Getting started with {improveR}
text: Workflows chain together analytical steps organized analysis trees:
code: # Create an analysis tree analysisTree <- createAnalysisTree(   targetIdent = "/Projects/my-analysis",   treeName = "EDA_Workflow",   comment = "Exploratory data analysis" )  # Create a step environment stepEnv <- createStepTemplateEnv(treeIdent = analysisTree)  # Configure the step stepEnv$setStepDescription("Load and prepare data") stepEnv$setStepRationale("Initial data loading and validation")  # Add input files stepEnv$addStepRemoteFile(ident = dataFile$entityId, variableName = "input-data")  # Set execution configuration stepEnv$setStepRunserverLabel("runserver") stepEnv$setStepToolLabel("R_4.2") stepEnv$setStepToolInstance("rbatch")  # Create the step resultStep <- stepEnv$realise() step <- resultStep$getStepResource()

title: Getting started with {improveR}

text: First, let’s create R scripts workflow steps execute.

cat("
=== Creating Script Files ===
")  # Create a simple data loading script dataLoadScript <- '# Data Loading Script # This script loads the built-in iris dataset and saves it as CSV  # Load the iris dataset data(iris)  # Display basic information cat("Dataset: iris\n") cat("Dimensions:", nrow(iris), "rows x", ncol(iris), "columns\n") cat("Column names:", paste(names(iris), collapse = ", "), "\n")  # Summary statistics summary(iris)  # Save to CSV write.csv(iris, "iris_data.csv", row.names = FALSE) cat("\nData saved to iris_data.csv\n") '  # Write script locally writeLines(dataLoadScript, "load_iris_data.R")  # Upload to repository scriptFile <- createFile(   targetIdent = tutorialResource$entityId,   fileName = "load_iris_data.R",   localPath = "load_iris_data.R",   comment = "Script to load and save iris dataset" ) cat("Uploaded script:", scriptFile$path, "
")  # Create an analysis script analysisScript <- '# Data Analysis Script # This script performs basic analysis on the iris dataset  # Check if data file exists if (!file.exists("iris_data.csv")) {   stop("iris_data.csv not found. Run data loading step first.") }  # Load the data iris_data <- read.csv("iris_data.csv") cat("Loaded data with", nrow(iris_data), "observations\n")  # Create visualizations pdf("iris_analysis.pdf")  # Pairwise scatter plots pairs(iris_data[, 1:4],        main = "Iris Dataset - Pairwise Relationships",       pch = 21,        bg = c("red", "green", "blue")[unclass(iris_data$Species)])  # Box plots by species par(mfrow = c(2, 2)) for (col in names(iris_data)[1:4]) {   boxplot(iris_data[[col]] ~ iris_data$Species,           main = col,           xlab = "Species",           ylab = col,           col = c("red", "green", "blue")) }  dev.off() cat("\nAnalysis plots saved to iris_analysis.pdf\n")  # Calculate means by species species_means <- aggregate(. ~ Species, data = iris_data, FUN = mean) write.csv(species_means, "species_means.csv", row.names = FALSE) cat("Species means saved to species_means.csv\n")  # Print summary print(species_means) '  writeLines(analysisScript, "analyze_iris_data.R")  analysisFile <- createFile(   targetIdent = tutorialResource$entityId,   fileName = "analyze_iris_data.R",   localPath = "analyze_iris_data.R",   comment = "Script to analyze iris dataset" ) cat("Uploaded analysis script:", analysisFile$path, "
")  # Clean up local files unlink(c("load_iris_data.R", "analyze_iris_data.R"))

") cat("Step path:", loadStep$path, "

title: Workflows basic
code: cat("\n=== Workflow Best Practices ===\n")  cat(" 1. Step Organization:    - Use descriptive names for steps    - Document rationale for each step    - Organize steps hierarchically in analysis trees  2. Data Flow:    - Use links to connect step outputs to inputs    - Links ensure reproducibility by pointing to specific versions    - Document expected inputs and outputs  3. Configuration:    - Store runserver configuration in variables or config files    - Use consistent tool versions across related steps    - Document tool requirements  4. Error Handling:    - Check for required input files    - Provide meaningful error messages    - Save logs and intermediate results  5. Reproducibility:    - All inputs should be versioned    - Record tool versions and parameters    - Capture execution environment details ")
